text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: latency_slo_burn_eu - p99 latency > 3000ms for 5m, SLO burn 18% (auto-page)
pd-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-8732 triggered (severity: P1) -> on-call: @sre-oncall-maya, escalation policy: europe-low-latency
sre-oncall-maya: acked INC-8732. jumping in — thanks. first check: are we seeing model or infra? @platform-arjun can you pull cluster kv-cache metrics?
platform-arjun: pulling metrics now. kv-cache hit rate in eu-prod dropped from 92% -> 37% around 1872345200. also saw a spike in avg seq length starting at 1872345000.
eng-karen: we rolled model/tx-embed-v2 at 1872344800 to canary->50% earlier today. could be cache invalidation due to new opt/embedding keys.
sre-oncall-maya: hypothesis: new model variant changed key shape, causing KV cache misses -> backend overloaded -> p99 tail. quick mitigations: 1) route traffic off canary to v1 2) increase pool size 3) bump KV TTL to prevent thrash. which is fastest?
platform-arjun: fastest is reroute canary -> v1 (config change). increasing dedicated pool takes ~3-5m for scale up. TTL change is risky but can try short delta.
sre-backup-miguel: important to check autoscaler logs too. last scale event was inhibited by policy "no-burst-after-deploy" which is on by default.
sre-oncall-maya: ok doing reroute now: `/infra/router set-route --service=embed-eu --version=model/tx-embed-v1 --weight=100`
incidents-bot: command accepted, routing change initiated.
platform-arjun: router shows traffic flip in progress, 60% -> 100% to v1 within 30s.
eng-karen: logging note: we saw changed cache key prefix from `embed_v1:` -> `embed_v2:` after the deploy. That aligns.
sre-oncall-maya: monitoring p95/p99 now. also temporarily disabling "no-burst-after-deploy" for EU pools to let autoscaler kick: `/infra/autoscaler override --region=eu --policy=no-burst-after-deploy --duration=10m` (will watch)
platform-arjun: override applied.
incidents-bot: p99 latency trending down: 4.2s -> 2.1s after reroute. p95 ~ 600ms -> 320ms.
sre-oncall-maya: good sign. keeping watch. @support-alia can you surface any open customer tickets that mention slow responses in EU in last 30m?
support-alia: pulling. found 2 inbound support threads (SUP-1129, SUP-1130) reporting intermittent timeouts around 1872345300. I've added incident tag and notified account owners. customer impact: degraded for 12% of requests in EU for the last 8 minutes, most requests were retries from SDKs.
eng-karen: we should rollback canary deploy later once root cause fully validated. immediate next steps: 1) keep routing to v1 for 30m, 2) fix cache key generation in tx-embed-v2, 3) run a warmup job to populate kv keys before re-enabling canary.
sre-oncall-maya: agree. I'm putting a mitigation timeline: short-term (now) reroute + autoscaler override. mid-term (30-90m) rollback canary and warmup. long-term: add deploy gating test that validates kv key schema and run warmup job as part of rollout.
platform-arjun: for warmup we can run `/jobs/warmup --service=embed-eu --model=tx-embed-v2 --keys=popular-queries --concurrency=10`
eng-karen: I'll open a PR to fix key format and add an integration check. assigning to @eng-karen, will request review from infra.
sre-oncall-maya: paging notes: ACKed -> mitigated by reroute. keeping incident open for postmortem and customer comms. handing off to @sre-backup-miguel in 25m for overnight watch.
sre-backup-miguel: standing by. if p99 goes above 2.5s again escalate to infra lead @platform-arjun and product @eng-karen.
sre-oncall-maya: adding to incident: `impact: EU latency SLO burn, p99 peaked ~4.8s, ~12% errors/retries, affected embed endpoint only, likely KV key mismatch after canary deploy`.
incidents-bot: NOTE: next scheduled oncall rotation in 30m.
sre-oncall-maya: creating incident ticket INC-8732 with summary and actions, linking support threads SUP-1129, SUP-1130. Also triggering postmortem template.
sre-oncall-maya: final before handoff — checklist: 1) route = v1 (done) 2) autoscaler override = active (done) 3) support notified (done) 4) PR to fix key schema (in progress) 5) warmup job scheduled (planned)
sre-backup-miguel: I have context. will monitor dashboards for 1h, will escalate per above. @support-alia please prepare customer-facing status update: we identified a regression from a canary model change, rolling back to stable, investigating fixes. keep it short.
support-alia: drafting status, will post to affected customers and update support tickets. ETA for detailed update: 30m.
sre-oncall-maya: handing off at 1872346892. leaving incident open for postmortem once root cause confirmed. thanks all.
pd-bot: INC-8732 status: acknowledged by maya, mitigated (routing change) — assigned to miguel for follow-up. Escalation policy standby.
sre-backup-miguel: acknowledged handoff. continuing watch. will update final resolution when PR merged or canary re-enabled safely.
